license_required.quote: practices dentistry, dental hygiene, dental therapy or expanded function dental assistance in this State without a license

issuing_authority.value: Board of Dental Examiners of Nevada
issuing_authority.quote: the Board of Dental Examiners of Nevada waive the requirements of NRS 631.240

name.value: Board of Dental Examiners of Nevada
name.quote: the Board of Dental Examiners of Nevada waive the requirements of NRS 631.240

type.quote: the Board, under rules and regulations adopted by it, shall determine the qualifications of the applicant and shall issue to each person found by the Board to have the qualifications therefor a license which will entitle the person to practice dental hygiene, dental therapy, dentistry or expanded function dental assistance

age_minimum.quote: Is over the age of 21 years

degree_required.value: Graduate of an accredited dental school or college
degree_required.quote: Is a graduate of an accredited dental school or college

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association
accrediting_body.quote: approved by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association or its successor organization

exams.name: National Board Dental Examination
exams.notes: Must present certificate from Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations with passing score of at least 75
exams.quote: must present to the Board a certificate granted by the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations which contains a notation that the applicant has passed the National Board Dental Examination with an average score of at least 75

exams.name: Clinical examination approved by the Board and the American Board of Dental Examiners or Western Regional Examining Board
exams.notes: Applicant must pass a clinical examination approved by the Board and ABDE, or present a WREB certificate
exams.quote: Successfully pass a clinical examination approved by the Board and the American Board of Dental Examiners; or Present to the Board a certificate granted by the Western Regional Examining Board

exams.name: Written examination on chapter contents and Board regulations
exams.notes: Board examines each applicant in writing on the contents and interpretation of the chapter and Board regulations
exams.quote: The Board shall examine each applicant in writing on the contents and interpretation of this chapter and the regulations of the Board.

interval_years.quote: All other licenses must be renewed biennially.

required.quote: Submission of proof of completion of the required continuing education

period_years.quote: be granted a renewal certificate which will authorize continuation of the practice for 2 years

value: Medical consequences of an act of terrorism involving a weapon of mass destruction (at least 4 hours, within 2 years of initial licensure)
Screening, brief intervention and referral to treatment approach to substance use disorder (at least 2 hours, within 2 years of initial licensure)

Training relating to persons with substance use and other addictive disorders and the prescribing of opioids (at least 2 hours per licensure period, for dentists registered to dispense controlled substances)
Teledentistry (at least 2 hours, if providing teledentistry services)
topical_requirements.quote: each licensee must complete a course of instruction, within 2 years after initial licensure, relating to the medical consequences of an act of terrorism

available.quote: the Board shall, without a clinical examination required by NRS 631.240, issue a temporary license to practice dentistry to a person who: Has a license to practice dentistry issued pursuant to the laws of another state or territory of the United States, or the District of Columbia

requirements.value: Must hold a valid license from another state/territory/DC, have practiced for at least 5 years, have no revocations/suspensions/refusals/pending disciplinary actions, pay required fees, submit all application information, and satisfy moral character requirements.
requirements.quote: Has a license to practice dentistry issued pursuant to the laws of another state or territory of the United States, or the District of Columbia; Has practiced dentistry pursuant to the laws of another state or territory of the United States, or the District of Columbia, for a minimum of 5 years

regulatory_model.quote: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 629.091, practices dentistry, dental hygiene, dental therapy or expanded function dental assistance in this State without a license

credential_type.quote: shall issue to each person found by the Board to have the qualifications therefor a license which will entitle the person to practice dental hygiene, dental therapy, dentistry or expanded function dental assistance

is_mandatory.quote: A person who engages in the illegal practice of dentistry in this State is guilty of a category D felony

title_protection.quote: Assumes the degree of "Doctor of Dental Surgery" or "Doctor of Dental Medicine" or appends the letters "D.D.S." or "D.M.D." or "R.D.H." to his or her name, not having conferred upon him or her, by diploma from an accredited dental or dental hygiene college or school legally empowered to confer the title, the right to assume the title

scope_protection.quote: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 629.091, practices dentistry, dental hygiene, dental therapy or expanded function dental assistance in this State without a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing any student or suspended/unlicensed dentist, dental hygienist, dental therapist, or expanded function dental assistant to perform dental operations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing, directly or indirectly, any student or any suspended or unlicensed dentist, dental hygienist, dental therapist or expanded function dental assistant to perform operations of any kind to treat or correct the teeth or jaws

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing, procuring, inducing, aiding or abetting a person not licensed as a dentist to engage in the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing, procuring, inducing, aiding or abetting a person not licensed or registered as a dentist to engage in the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing while a license is suspended or without a renewal certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing while a license is suspended or without a renewal certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dividing or agreeing to divide fees with any person for bringing or referring a patient without the patient's knowledge
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dividing fees or agreeing to divide fees received for services with any person for bringing or referring a patient, without the knowledge of the patient or his or her legal representative

disciplinary_grounds.description: Associating with or lending name to any person engaged in the illegal practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Associating with or lending his or her name to any person engaged in the illegal practice of dentistry or associating with any person, firm or corporation holding himself, herself or itself out in any manner contrary to the provisions of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Malpractice — failure to exercise the degree of care, diligence and skill ordinarily exercised by dentists in good standing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Malpractice;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional incompetence — lack of ability safely and skillfully to practice dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional incompetence;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension or revocation of a license to practice dentistry, or imposition of a fine or other disciplinary action by another state's regulatory agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension or revocation of a license to practice dentistry, the imposition of a fine or other disciplinary action by any agency of another state authorized to regulate the practice of dentistry in that state

disciplinary_grounds.description: More than one act constituting substandard care in the practice of dentistry, dental hygiene, dental therapy or expanded function dental assistance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: More than one act by the dentist, dental hygienist, dental therapist or expanded function dental assistant constituting substandard care in the practice of dentistry, dental hygiene, dental therapy or expanded function dental assistance, as applicable

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any controlled substance or dangerous drug not required to treat the patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any controlled substance or any dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS, if it is not required to treat the dentist's patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly procuring or administering a controlled substance or dangerous drug not approved by the FDA (with limited exceptions)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly procuring or administering a controlled substance or a dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS that is not approved by the United States Food and Drug Administration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having an alcohol or other substance use disorder rendering the person unsafe or unreliable as a practitioner, or gross immorality
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having an alcohol or other substance use disorder to such an extent as to render the person unsafe or unreliable as a practitioner, or such gross immorality as tends to bring reproach upon the dental profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude or relating to the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude or which relates to the practice of dentistry in this State, or conviction of any criminal violation of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with controlled substance and prescription monitoring provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the provisions of NRS 453.163, 453.164, 453.226, 639.23507, 639.23535 and 639.2391 to 639.23916, inclusive

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent, illegal, unauthorized or otherwise inappropriate prescribing, administering or dispensing of a controlled substance in schedule II, III or IV
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulent, illegal, unauthorized or otherwise inappropriate prescribing, administering or dispensing of a controlled substance listed in schedule II, III or IV

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to actively involve a patient in decisions concerning his or her treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to actively involve a patient in decisions concerning his or her treatment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Requiring a patient to enter into an agreement that restricts the ability of the patient to submit a complaint to the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Requiring a patient to enter into an agreement that restricts the ability of the patient to submit a complaint to the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering an immunization without holding the required special endorsement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering an immunization if the dentist, dental hygienist or dental therapist does not hold a special endorsement issued pursuant to NRS 631.285

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to review diagnostic radiographs for orthodontia before making an initial diagnosis or using an orthodontic appliance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to review diagnostic digital or conventional radiographs for orthodontia before: Making an initial diagnosis of or taking any action to correct malpositions of teeth; or The initial use of an orthodontic appliance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing or circulating fraudulent, false or misleading statements about a dentist's skill or method of practice, or using false or misleading advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Publishing or circulating, directly or indirectly, any fraudulent, false or misleading statement concerning the skill or method of practice of any dentist; Using advertising which is false or misleading

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using fraud or misrepresentation to secure a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using fraud or misrepresentation to secure a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Submitting a false or fraudulent claim for payment to an insurer for dental services rendered
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Submitting a false or fraudulent claim for payment to an insurer for dental services rendered

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or repeated violations of the provisions of this chapter or regulations of the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or repeated violations of the provisions of this chapter; Willful or repeated violations of the regulations of the State Board of Health, the State Board of Pharmacy or the Board of Dental Examiners of Nevada

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to make the health care records of a patient available for inspection and copying as required by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to make the health care records of a patient available for inspection and copying as provided in NRS 629.061

definition_quote.value: Dentistry means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention and treatment of diseases, disorders and conditions of the oral cavity, the maxillofacial area and the adjacent and associated structures and their impact on the human body, which care is provided by a dentist within the scope of his or her education, training and experience in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law.
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention and treatment of diseases, disorders and conditions of the oral cavity, the maxillofacial area and the adjacent and associated structures and their impact on the human body, which care is provided by a dentist within the scope of his or her education, training and experience in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law.

value: Evaluation and diagnosis of diseases, disorders and conditions of the oral cavity and maxillofacial area
Prevention and treatment (surgical and nonsurgical) of oral diseases, disorders and conditions
Extraction of teeth
Correction of malpositions of teeth or jaws
Taking impressions of teeth, mouth or gums
Supplying and placing artificial teeth
Administering or prescribing remedies for dental or oral diseases
Use of X-ray radiation or laser radiation for dental treatment or diagnostic purposes
Dispensing tooth whitening agents or whitening/bleaching teeth
Determining whether and which treatment is necessary or advisable
methods_authorized.quote: Any person shall be deemed to be practicing dentistry who: (a) Uses words or any letters or title in connection with his or her name which in any way represents the person as engaged in the practice of dentistry, or any branch thereof; ... (c) Evaluates or diagnoses, professes to evaluate or diagnose or treats or professes to treat, surgically or nonsurgically, any of the diseases, disorders, conditions or lesions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area or the adjacent and associated structures

drug_authority.value: A licensed dentist may administer or prescribe remedies, medicinal or otherwise, as needed in the treatment of dental or oral diseases; dentists registered to dispense controlled substances must comply with applicable controlled substance laws and complete required training.
drug_authority.quote: Administers or prescribes such remedies, medicinal or otherwise, as are needed in the treatment of dental or oral diseases

value: general anesthesia
minimal sedation
moderate sedation
deep sedation
sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: No licensed dentist or person who holds a restricted license issued pursuant to NRS 631.275 may administer or supervise directly the administration of general anesthesia, minimal sedation, moderate sedation or deep sedation to dental patients unless the dentist or person has been issued a permit authorizing him or her to do so by the Board.

specialist_license_available.quote: The Board may issue a specialist's license authorizing a dentist licensed in this State to announce, hold himself or herself out and practice as a specialist in a special area of dentistry for which there is a certifying board approved by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association.

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: A dentist licensed in this State to whom a specialist's license is issued shall limit his or her practice to the specialty.

value: supervision by a dentist (physically present in the office)
authorization by a licensed dentist (dentist not required to be present)
public health dental hygiene special endorsement (without authorization or supervision of a dentist, as specified by Board regulations)
dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: A dentist who provides a written or oral authorization to a dental hygienist for the provision of services by that dental hygienist is not required to be present when those services are provided.

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: the holder of a license or renewal certificate to practice dental therapy may practice only in the settings provided in subsection 3, under the authorization of a dentist meeting the requirements of subsection 4 and in accordance with a written practice agreement signed by the dental therapist and the authorizing dentist.

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: An authorizing dentist may not simultaneously maintain written practice agreements required pursuant to NRS 631.3122 with more than four full-time or full-time equivalent dental therapists.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: The Board shall, upon application by a dental hygienist who is licensed pursuant to this chapter and has such qualifications as the Board specifies by regulation, issue a special endorsement of the license allowing the dental hygienist to practice public health dental hygiene.

value: patients served through public health dental hygiene programs approved by the Board
patients in school health activities
patients of public health agencies
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: A dental hygienist who holds a special endorsement issued pursuant to subsection 1 may provide services without the authorization or supervision of a dentist only as specified by regulations adopted by the Board.

dental_therapist_license_available.quote: "Dental therapist" means any person who practices the profession of dental therapy and is licensed pursuant to this chapter.

dental_therapist_collaborative_practice_.quote: the holder of a license or renewal certificate to practice dental therapy may practice only in the settings provided in subsection 3, under the authorization of a dentist meeting the requirements of subsection 4 and in accordance with a written practice agreement signed by the dental therapist and the authorizing dentist.

value: A hospital
A rural health clinic
A federally qualified health center or health facility reimbursed as such
A federally qualified health center licensed as a health facility or agency
An outpatient health program or facility operated by a tribe or tribal organization
A school-based health center

Any other clinic or practice setting (including mobile dental unit) where at least 50% of patients are enrolled in a state health care program, have a medical disability or chronic condition creating a significant barrier to dental care, or lack dental coverage and have household income below 200% of federal poverty level
dental_therapist_practice_setting_restri.quote: The holder of a license or renewal certificate to practice dental therapy may practice only in the following settings

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 631.385, owns or controls a dental practice, shares in the fees received by a dentist or controls or attempts to control the services offered by a dentist if the person is not himself or herself licensed pursuant to this chapter

opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: The Board shall, by regulation, require each holder of a license to practice dentistry who is registered to dispense controlled substances pursuant to NRS 453.231 to complete at least 2 hours of training relating specifically to persons with substance use and other addictive disorders and the prescribing of opioids during each period of licensure.

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: Failure to comply with the provisions of NRS 453.163, 453.164, 453.226, 639.23507, 639.23535 and 639.2391 to 639.23916, inclusive, and any regulations adopted by the State Board of Pharmacy pursuant thereto

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Prohibits the performance of mechanical work, on inanimate objects only, by any person employed in or operating a dental laboratory upon the written work authorization of a licensed dentist.

denture_patient_identification_marking_r.quote: All artificial teeth, dentures or other removable dental appliances, at the time they are manufactured or sent to a laboratory for repair, must be identified with the name or social security number of the owner

teledentistry_authorized.quote: "Teledentistry" means the use of telehealth by a licensee described in subsection 1 of NRS 631.3458 who is located at a distant site to facilitate the diagnosis, treatment, education, care management and self-management of or consultation with a patient who is located at an originating site.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: A dental hygienist may, pursuant to regulations adopted by the Board, administer local anesthesia or nitrous oxide in a health care facility, as defined in NRS 162A.740, if: (a) The dental hygienist is so authorized by the licensed dentist of the patient

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: A dental hygienist may, pursuant to regulations adopted by the Board, administer local anesthesia or nitrous oxide in a health care facility, as defined in NRS 162A.740, if: (a) The dental hygienist is so authorized by the licensed dentist of the patient

restorative_function_endorsement_availab.quote: The Board shall, upon application by a dental hygienist who has the qualifications prescribed by subsection 2, issue a special endorsement of the license allowing the dental hygienist to practice restorative dental hygiene pursuant to NRS 631.3129.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: Holds a current certification in the techniques of administering cardiopulmonary resuscitation

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: The Board shall, upon application by a dental hygienist who is licensed pursuant to this chapter and has such qualifications as the Board specifies by regulation, issue a special endorsement of the license allowing the dental hygienist to practice public health dental hygiene.
